description: This PHP class defines a Comment model within a blogging system, handling retrieval, listing, counting, validation, saving, and deletion of comments associated with blog posts. It interacts with database tables for comments, posts, and users, and incorporates functionalities for text processing and user management.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Model class representing comments on blog posts, providing methods for CRUD operations, retrieval, and validation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by ID, processes its text to link URLs and convert new lines.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all comments for a specific post, enriching each with user data and formatting.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of comments associated with a blog, with optional limit, ordered descending.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Counts comments for a given post, updating the post's comment count if necessary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates comment data, ensuring text is present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the comment to the database after validation and content filtering, updating comment count.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a comment by ID and updates the related post's comment count.
